summary: A train begins a journey from a station and travels 60 km in a time of 20 minutes. What is the average speed of the train? A 3.0 m / s

summary: What is weight? A a frictional force B
explanation: C, because weight is the downward gravitational force exerted on an object's mass in a gravitational field ($W = mg$).

summary: The diagram shows a bird in flight. The bird is flying in a horizontal direction to the right. In which direction does air resistance act on the bird? A D
explanation: D, because air resistance (drag) is a resistive frictional force that directly opposes the direction of motion through the air. Since the bird is flying horizontally to the right, air resistance must act horizontally to the left (D).

summary: A small bottle has a mass of 20 g when empty. The volume of the bottle is 10 cm3. When full of liquid, the total mass is 150 g. What is the density of the liquid? A
explanation: C, because the mass of liquid is total mass minus the empty bottle mass: $m = 150\text{ g} - 20\text{ g} = 130\text{ g}$. Density is mass divided by volume: $\rho = \frac{m}{V} = \frac{130\text{ g}}{10\text{ cm}^3} = 13\text{ g/cm}^3$.

summary: A rocket is travelling vertically upwards. Three vertical forces act on it. The thrust acts upwards and is equal to 100 000 N. The weight acts downwards and is equal to 80 000 N. W
explanation: A, because at constant speed, resultant force is zero ($F_{\text{net}} = 0$). Upward forces must balance downward forces: $\text{Thrust (up)} = \text{Weight (down)} + F_{\text{drag}} \implies 100\,000 = 80\,000 + F_{\text{drag}} \implies F_{\text{drag}} = 20\,000\text{ N}$ downwards.
